t: Long ago there was a man called Daniel. When he was young he was taken far from home, to the great city of Babylon. He loved God more than anything, and he prayed to Him every day.
m: Narrator | storyteller opening, warm and unhurried; a little wonder on 大大的巴比伦城 / 'great city'; soft and fond on the last sentence | at most 15.0 s
d: Picture: bedtime, a big picture book open, the child leaning on you. (Daniel 1:1-6; 6:10)

t: Daniel, you're wise and you're honest. I can trust you with anything! I'm going to put you in charge of my whole kingdom!
m: King Darius | a big, warm king, pleased with his friend; generous, a laugh in the voice on 我都放心 / 'anything'; grand on the last sentence | at most 10.1 s
d: Picture: you pat your best friend on the shoulder and tell him he's the best. (Daniel 6:1-3)

t: Thank you, Your Majesty! I'll do my very best. Any wisdom I have... comes from God.
m: Daniel | humble and calm, a kind grown-up man; a small smile; slower on the last phrase | at most 6.9 s
d: Picture: someone praises you and you smile: 'it wasn't really me'. (Daniel 2:28; 6:3)

t: Hmph! Why him? I looked and looked for something he did wrong... and I couldn't find a thing! He's too honest!
m: The jealous official | sulky, jealous, a bit whiny; a loud 哼 / 'hmph' first; speeds up on 找啊找 / 'looked and looked'; exasperated wail on the last words | at most 8.8 s
d: Picture: another child got the gold star, not you, and you stamp your foot. (Daniel 6:4)

t: Wait a minute... he prays to his God every day. Heh heh. I've got an idea!
m: The jealous official | sly, slowing down as the idea comes; a sneaky giggle; whispered and cheeky on the end | at most 9.1 s
d: Picture: you've thought of a prank and giggle behind your hand. (Daniel 6:5)

t: O great King, live forever! Please make a new law: for thirty days, everyone must pray only to you! Anyone who doesn't gets thrown to the lions!
m: The jealous official | oily, over-sweet flattery, bowing; big on 伟大的王 / 'great King'; then quick and pushy; a wicked little relish on 狮子坑 / 'lions' | at most 13.7 s
d: Picture: you want a sweet, so you tell Mum she's the most beautiful mum ever. (Daniel 6:6-7)

t: Only to me? Hmm... that sounds rather nice! Seal it!
m: King Darius | flattered and a little vain, chuckling; a thinking 嗯 / 'hmm'; brisk and pleased on 盖章 / 'Seal it' | at most 4.9 s
d: Picture: someone flatters you and you puff out your chest: 'Of course!' (Daniel 6:8-9)

t: Daniel heard about the new law. But he went home just as he always did, opened his window toward Jerusalem, and knelt down to pray, three times a day.
m: Narrator | quiet and admiring; a small pause after 可他还是 / 'But'; steady and slow on 一天三次 / 'three times a day' | at most 14.2 s
d: Picture: every night, the same way, you kneel by the bed to pray. (Daniel 6:10)

t: Dear God, I know about the new law... but You are my God, and I will pray only to You. Please help me, and please help our king too.
m: Daniel | a real prayer, soft and close, not preachy; calm, trusting; a breath before 可你是 / 'but You are'; gentle and kind on 也帮助我们的王 | at most 14.5 s
d: Picture: you whisper what's in your heart to God. (Daniel 6:10; 9:3-4)

t: Shh! Look! He's praying! Got you now! Heh heh heh, I'm going straight to the king!
m: The jealous official | whisper at first, gleeful and nasty; rising to a nasty little cackle; quick and excited at the end | at most 8.3 s
d: Picture: hiding behind a door, you've just found out someone's secret. (Daniel 6:11-12)

t: Your Majesty! Daniel broke your law! He's still praying to his God! Throw him to the lions!
m: The jealous official | tattling, triumphant, pointing; fast and shrill | at most 8.3 s
d: Picture: you run to the teacher: 'He broke the rule!' (Daniel 6:13)

t: What? Daniel? No, no... I have to find a way to save him!
m: King Darius | shocked, then upset and fumbling; the 不行不行 / 'no, no' tumbles out; determined but afraid on the last half | at most 5.8 s
d: Picture: you hear your best friend is in trouble and you can't keep still. (Daniel 6:14)

t: Oh, Your Majesty, did you forget? A law with your seal on it can never be changed!
m: The jealous official | smug, sing-song, mock-polite; a nasty little 哦 / 'never' at the end | at most 7.1 s
d: Picture: you remind someone 'you promised!' and grin inside. (Daniel 6:15)

t: Oh... how could I be so foolish!
m: King Darius | a long groan of regret, real sorrow, almost tearful | at most 3.4 s
d: Picture: you did something wrong and hold your head in your hands. (Daniel 6:14)

t: The king had no choice. Daniel was taken to the lions' den.
m: Narrator | low and serious, but gentle; not scary | at most 5.3 s
d: Picture: it's getting dark; the story reaches the hard part. (Daniel 6:16)

t: Daniel... the God you serve every day... He will save you!
m: King Darius | choked up but full of hope; a catch in the voice on 但以理; firm and sure on 一定会救你 | at most 6.0 s
d: Picture: seeing your friend off on a hard trip, tears in your eyes, cheering him on. (Daniel 6:16)

t: Don't be afraid, Your Majesty. God is with me.
m: Daniel | peaceful, comforting the king; quiet strength, a small smile | at most 5.7 s
d: Picture: you pat your scared little sister: 'Don't worry, I'm here.' (Daniel 6:16; Psalm 23:4)

t: It was dark in the den. The lions crept closer and closer... but Daniel wasn't afraid. He knelt down and prayed.
m: Narrator | hushed and suspenseful, slow on 慢慢走过来 / 'crept closer'; then calm and warm on 没有害怕 / 'wasn't afraid' | at most 9.6 s
d: Picture: lights off, you reach the most exciting part of the bedtime story. (Daniel 6:16-17)

t: Suddenly, a light shone in! God sent an angel to shut the lions' mouths. And look... the lion gave a great big yawn, lay down, and purred like a giant kitty cat!
m: Narrator | wonder on the light (slow, awed), then a delighted giggle building through 大哈欠 / 'big yawn' to 呼噜呼噜 / 'purred'; playful and happy | at most 13.1 s
d: Picture: a huge lion purring like a kitten, and you can't help laughing. (Daniel 6:22)

t: All night long the king couldn't eat, and he couldn't sleep.
m: Narrator | a little funny-sad, like telling about a grown-up who worries too much | at most 4.6 s
d: Picture: Dad can't sleep and walks up and down the house at night. (Daniel 6:18)

t: Oh dear... how is Daniel? I can't sleep... I just can't sleep!
m: King Darius | restless, fretting, a big tired sigh; a comic whimper on the second 睡不着 / 'can't sleep' | at most 8.4 s
d: Picture: it's the night before the school trip and you just can't sleep. (Daniel 6:18)

t: Daniel! Daniel! Has your God... been able to save you?
m: King Darius | out of breath from running, anxious, calling loudly into the den; voice cracks with worry on the question | at most 6.8 s
d: Picture: you're calling for your lost puppy across the playground. (Daniel 6:19-20)

t: Your Majesty, I'm fine! God sent His angel to shut the lions' mouths. They didn't hurt me at all!
m: Daniel | joyful and calling up from the den, a happy laugh in it; strong and bright | at most 8.6 s
d: Picture: found in hide-and-seek, you shout 'I'm here!' (Daniel 6:21-22)

t: Wonderful! Quick, quick, roll the stone away!
m: King Darius | huge relief, laughing, bossy-happy; quick 快快 / 'quick, quick' | at most 3.4 s
d: Picture: you've found your lost puppy and jump for joy. (Daniel 6:23)

t: Daniel walked out of the lions' den without a single scratch! Because he trusted in God.
m: Narrator | glad, a little amazed; slow and warm on the last sentence | at most 7.6 s
d: Picture: you fell over, got up, and there isn't a scratch on you. (Daniel 6:23)

t: Uh... well... I'll just be going now...
m: The jealous official | caught out, nervous, mumbling, trying to sound casual; trails off | at most 6.0 s
d: Picture: caught with your hand in the biscuit tin, you try to slip away. (Daniel 6:24 (softened))

t: Waaah! Help!
m: The jealous official | a high, comic shriek of fright, cartoon-style; it trails away as he runs | at most 5.7 s
d: Picture: a big dog runs at you and you flee, shrieking. (Daniel 6:24 (softened))

t: Hear this, everyone in my kingdom! Daniel's God is the living God! He rescues, and He keeps His people safe!
m: King Darius | a king's big proclamation, but joyful, not stern; arms open; strong and ringing | at most 8.7 s
d: Picture: you stand up high and shout good news to the whole world. (Daniel 6:25-27)

t: Even when things were hard, Daniel kept on praying. You can talk to God any time too. He's always listening!
m: Narrator | warm moral, speaking right to the child; smile on the last sentence | at most 7.9 s
d: Picture: the story is over and you stroke the child's hair. (Daniel 6:10; Philippians 4:6)
